title: Fleet Arrival Count
commonMistakes: Processing cars from the back of the road instead of from the destination backward
Comparing speeds instead of uninterrupted arrival times
Creating a new fleet when two cars arrive at exactly the same time
Forgetting to sort the cars by starting position
Assuming every car starts in sorted position order
followUps: How would you also report the size of each fleet?
Can you process the cars without storing pairs if the positions are given in order?
How would a car with zero speed change the result?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
